description: The swift.org Swift toolchain in /usr, and the packages replay's Linux build and tests need (build-linux.sh, test suite). For Debian 13 images. The defaults match the Docker pin in linux/swift-image; for another version or platform set swift, platform and sha256 together. A box of it needs no network: the build reads nothing from the internet.

swift.description: The Swift release, e.g. 6.2.4 (keep it equal to linux/swift-image)

platform.description: swift.org's build for this system: debian12-aarch64 (swift.org has no Debian 13 build of 6.2.4; the Debian 12 build runs on Debian 13)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of that tarball, taken from a download whose swift.org signature was checked with gpg

steps.name: What the Swift toolchain links against, and the test suite's tools
steps.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install --no-install-recommends binutils libc6-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libgcc-14-dev libpython3-dev libsqlite3-0 libstdc++-14-dev libxml2-dev libncurses-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata zlib1g-dev attr zip

steps.name: Swift from swift.org, checked against its SHA-256

update.name: The packages, the distribution's newest
update.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install --no-install-recommends --only-upgrade binutils libc6-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libgcc-14-dev libpython3-dev libsqlite3-0 libstdc++-14-dev libxml2-dev libncurses-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata zlib1g-dev attr zip

update.name: Swift, when the parameters name another release
